title: Ramsays' $14,000 retrieval reenactment
plain: Suzanne Ramsey says she and her family spent "in excess of $14,000 that week" to stage a reenactment of a crashed craft being recovered at Hart Canyon, near Aztec, New Mexico. She tells Michels this as something she took part in, on an episode about a crash there said to have left 16 alien bodies. The Ramseys did it to show how such a recovery could have been carried out at that spot.
